<function name="OnGetFocus" parent="DTextEntry" type="panelhook">
	<description>Called whenever the <page>DTextEntry</page> gains focus.</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<file line="336-L348">lua/vgui/dtextentry.lua</file>
</function>

<example>
	<code>
local dTextEntry = vgui.Create("DTextEntry")
dTextEntry:SetText("Enter text here")

-- Make the text field clear when you click into it.
dTextEntry.OnGetFocus = function(self)
    self:SetValue("")
end
	</code>
	<output>Text entry clears when user clicks it to begin typing</output>

</example>
